'''Dermoid Cysts''' are utility [[Blocks]] introduced in [[Version 1.10.0]]. They are currently a [[:Category:Work In Progress Content|Work In Progress]].

==''Obtainment''==
Dermoid Cysts can be harvested from the inside of [[Meteor|Meteors]] (two per Meteor), or they can be crafted with a [[Parasitic Cyst|Vacuous Cyst]], four [[Biome Blocks|Flesh Chunks]], and four [[Infected Flesh]].

==''Usage''==
Being a Work In Progress, Dermoid Cysts have a limited function, which is only to be a Chest crafted from parasite parts. It has no use or unique functionality other than this.<ref>In the game files, there are textures for "happy" and "open" versions, which may mean that the Dermoid Cyst will gain new usage, tiers, or animations on further development.</ref>
